text:
Morgan: heads-up — AcmePay filed a formal intake: they want us to onboard `xenon-13b-rl` for customer-facing payments assistant. latency target p95 < 250ms, deterministic outputs for auditing. link to request: https://redwood.internal/requests/ACME-342 :eyes:

csm_jordan: confirm — they have a POC commit for Dedicated capacity next month, they're asking if we can support quantized variant for cost. also want an SLA-ish report for hallucination audit.

Sam: ok. quick questions: which format are weights in (gguf/pt)? any fine-tuning/checkpoint info?

model-intake-bot: model metadata ingested: repo=https://models.acme/xenon, format=gguf, size=13B, license=apache-2.0, fingerprint=sha256:9f3a...

Priya: initial triage checklist (short):
- dataset: collect payments-specific promptset (10k anonymized queries)
- metrics: p95 latency, throughput, perplexity, exact-match for structured fields, hallucination rate (fact-check sampling), safety filters
- baselines: compare to `redwood/alex-13b` and `open/guanaco-13b`
- quant configs: q8_0, q4_0 (or q4_k_m), and int8 where supported
- acceptance criteria: delta in EM < 3% vs baseline, hallucination <= baseline + 1pp, p95 <= 250ms on Dedicated pool

Sam: sounds good. I'll add `xenon-13b-rl` to staging testpool (3x A10G) to start perf runs. Priya — want me to spin up a quant run first or do full fp16 eval?

Priya: start with fp16 eval for quality baseline, then q8 and q4 runs for perf delta. we should also run deterministic-seed tests (5 seeds) to surface nondeterminism.

alex: infra notes — for q4_0 we need to confirm kernel support on our runtime (cutlass/onednn fallback). if gguf includes per-tensor metadata we can auto-detect. Sam, expect some runtime patches; give me a heads-up before we push to dedicated.

Morgan: priority: P0 for onboarding queue because customer is paying for POC. timeline goal: baseline eval + quant experiments within 7 business days. owner: Priya (quality) + Sam (infra/perf). I'll own stakeholder comms.

Priya: mini plan with tasks:
1) prepare payments eval set (anonymize + sample 10k) — Priya + Jordan
2) fp16 baseline run vs our `alex-13b` — Priya (2d)
3) q8 and q4 experiments, measure latency & quality delta — Priya + Sam (3d)
4) safety/hallucination audit (manual 200 samples) — Priya (1d)
5) draft SLA report and rollout notes — Morgan (1d)

csm_jordan: I'll coordinate with AcmePay to get anonymized logs and confirm POC dates. also asked if we can expose a deterministic-mode flag for auditing.

Sam: quick eval command I'll run (local staging):
```\npython infra/run_eval.py \
  --model ./models/xenon-13b.gguf \
  --dataset data/payments_eval.jsonl \
  --batch 1 \
  --max_tokens 256 \
  --quant q4_0 \
  --seed 42 \
  --output results/xenon_q4_0.jsonl
```

Priya: example log snippet from a tiny q4_0 run (toy):
```
[INFO] load model xenon-13b.gguf (q4_0) -> 6.9GB
[INFO] batch=1 latency p50=32ms p95=180ms
[WARN] deterministic check: 2/100 mismatches across seeds
[METRIC] EM=0.742, hallucination_est=0.018
```

Priya: that toy run looks promising on perf but we need full eval to check EM delta vs `alex-13b`.

Morgan: next steps agreed. owners: Priya (lead), Sam (env/patches), alex (kernel validation), Jordan (customer logs). I'll add to intake tracker and create a canary rollout checklist in `#eng-releases` once tests pass. :white_check_mark:

Sam: I'll start the staging runs now and ping when results land.

alex: tagging infra ops to review kernel compat: @infra-oncall please glance when available.

model-intake-bot: ticket created: INTAKE-2026, assigned=[Priya,Sam], priority=P0

Morgan: thanks everyone — update in 24h with first fp16 baseline numbers. :rocket:
